history.content: Hi, my phone has absolutely no signal right now—nothing loads, I can't call or send picture messages, and I can't get online at all.

I can help you troubleshoot this issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can check your line status and assist you further.
My phone number is +1-617-555-0148 and my name is Sofia Martinez.

Thank you for the information. Your line status is currently active, so let's begin troubleshooting your no signal issue.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- If you see an airplane icon (✈️ Airplane Mode)
- What the signal bars show (if any)
- If you see any network type indicator (like 5G, 4G, LTE, etc.)

This will help me determine the next steps. If you need instructions on how to check, let me know!
I actually do see the airplane icon in the status bar, and it says 'No Signal'. There's also a data icon and my battery is at 87%.

It looks like Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone, which disables all wireless connections—including cellular service. To restore your signal, please turn off Airplane Mode. You can usually do this by:

1. Swiping down from the top of your screen to open the quick settings panel.
2. Tapping the airplane icon to turn it off.

Once Airplane Mode is off, wait a few seconds to see if your signal returns. Let me know if you see your signal bars come back or if you still have no service.
Airplane Mode is now off, but I still don't have any signal bars and it still says 'No Signal' at the top.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no signal, the next step is to check your SIM card status. Please check if your phone shows any messages about the SIM card (such as "No SIM," "SIM Locked," or "SIM Error"). 

If you’re not sure, you can try removing the SIM card from your phone and reinserting it, making sure it’s seated properly. After doing this, check if your signal returns.

Let me know if you see any changes or if you notice any SIM-related messages on your phone.
I don't see any messages about the SIM card like 'No SIM' or 'SIM Error'. I can try removing and reinserting the SIM card if you want.

Yes, please go ahead and remove the SIM card from your phone and then reinsert it, making sure it’s properly seated. After reinserting the SIM card, wait a few moments to see if your phone detects the SIM and if your signal returns.

Once you’ve done this, let me know if you see any changes in your signal or if any new messages appear on your phone.
After removing and reinserting the SIM card, it says the SIM is still Locked. Reseating didn't unlock it and I still have no signal.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your phone is showing that the SIM is "Locked," this means it requires a PIN or PUK code to unlock, which I am unable to provide directly.

I will transfer you to a human agent who can assist you further with unlocking your SIM card.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
